sections.heading: What You Can Expect From PTI
sections.body: Fair and equal access to training regardless of academic background, disability, or special needs. Hands-on instruction at a 75% practice / 25% theory ratio, under qualified instructors. Access to production-unit work, and a supervised industrial attachment placement after a minimum of 9 months. Preparation for and entry into DIT and UBTEB Trade Test examinations, and a testimonial from your industrial attachment partner on completion.

sections.heading: What PTI Expects From You
sections.body: Regular attendance and punctuality. Discipline and respect toward instructors, staff, fellow trainees, and members of the public served by the production units. Honest effort in both practical work and theory. Care for tools, equipment, and workshop/kitchen/lab/farm safety standards. Living out the Institute's core values: God Fearing, Discipline, Focused, Team Spirit, Passion.
